_note: FICTIONAL, DEMO ONLY. Loonstone Trust and Alex Carrow do not exist. This is the synthetic customer record the agent reads; every figure the agent says is checked against it.

renewal_offer.fees: No fee to renew, and no fee to switch between the two offered terms before the offer expires.
renewal_offer.if_nothing_chosen_by_maturity: The mortgage moves to the standard variable rate, currently 4.95%, with a monthly payment of 1,875.64. The customer can still choose a fixed term later.
renewal_offer.how_to_accept: The customer accepts in writing, in their own time, from the offer pack. The agent never accepts or binds a renewal on the call.
renewal_offer.human_review: The customer can ask for a person to review how the rate was set.

early_repayment_charge.method: Recalculated daily. The written quote is authoritative.
